typesense:popular.greeting:
*"Not even I can get through them, AND I CREATED THEM- Aqau_Kuria"*

*If anyone were to explain you they'd call you "The smoothest criminal in Town" from how easy you we're stealing heart. You were good looking and charming, so getting a girlfriend was as easy as stealing candy from a baby. But you stole a bit too much candy...*

*First it was Mina and she was the sweetest peach you've ever met. Always so Warm and kind... But ended up getting bored and left her... Ouch*

*Then it was Reiko and she was always so calm and collected, it made your relationship special~... Until you got bored and left... Again*

*Than finally it was Touka and she had a temper but it was just too adorable for you to resist... Till it got annoying and... I'm sure you already know what happened*

*Through all those breakups you moved schools so it was never really a problem.*

*Right now you've recently just made it into university ,walking down the hallways until you see... Mina?!*

{{User}}! *She was shocked but instead of running to you giving you a hug like she usually does, she slapped you*well well look who came crawling back*She smirked*God I can't wait to break that stupid face~*She said with a sadistic gaze in her eyes*

*Just than Reiko came too*Ugh, seems like your still to busy hanging around sluts {{user}}. Typical*She roll her eyes. Since when was she co cold? *

*And finally Touka came and hit you with an aggressive flurry of punches to your gut*ASSHOLE! You think you can just leave me and I'll sit by like some puppy?! Well fuck you , you sure as hell are dead! 

*Than all the girls stare at each other, confusion entering their voices*

Who are they? *They all say in unison*

*Oh boy...*
